description:
Find the exact moments a body returns to its natal longitude — solar returns
(the astrological "birthday", one per year), lunar returns (one per ~27.3
days), or any planetary return (e.g. Saturn return, one per ~29.5 years).

Examples:
  - "My solar return in 2026, born 1990-03-15 15:45 Riga" ->
    { body: "Sun", natal_datetime: "1990-03-15T15:45", natal_timezone: "Europe/Riga",
      from_datetime: "2026-01-01", to_datetime: "2027-01-01" }
  - "When is my Saturn return?" -> body: "Saturn" with a multi-year window
    around ages 27–31.

To cast the full chart for a return moment, pass the returned datetime to
compute_natal_chart with the person's current location.

body.description: Which body's return to find, e.g. "Sun", "Saturn".

natal_timezone.description: IANA timezone the datetime is local to, e.g. "Europe/Riga" or "America/New_York". Omit when the datetime already carries Z or a UTC offset.

to_datetime.description: End of the search window (max 120 years after start).

name: find_returns
title: Find Returns
